about_the_game:
The NSFW Realism Pack is an expansion for JASON: Coming of Age that enhances and enriches the adult visual experience of the game.
This DLC replaces over 600 NSFW 3D renders with reworked, more realistic versions, and adds more than 900 new videos, transforming many static scenes into immersive animations.
All content was created from the game’s original visuals and post-processed using artificial intelligence to increase realism while maintaining consistency with the established characters and universe.

content_descriptors.notes: The NSFW Realism Pack contains enhanced visual content based on the original game’s 3D renders. Existing scenes have been reworked through post-processing to increase realism, while maintaining consistency with the established characters. These improved still images were then used to generate realistic NSFW animations through an image-to-video AI process. No new characters, storylines, or sexual situations were added — it is an enhancement of the original material with higher visual fidelity.
